title: Places + Exposure: Polaroid compat
description: Datapack for Places that adds findable photos, slides and cameras.
body:
This datapack adds polaroid slides, polaroid cameras, photo albums and even custom photos into the file cabinet loot table, also changes a couple structures to contain Exposure related items.
Not adding pictures of the photos here so you can find them yourself without spoilers :3

The datapack requires [Exposure](https://modrinth.com/mod/exposure), [Exposure: Polaroid](https://modrinth.com/mod/exposure-polaroid) and any version of [Places](https://modrinth.com/mod/places) **higher than 0.4.9**
